Revenue from Huawei Technologies Co. Ltd. was 12% of total revenue for 2019. Revenue from Kingston Technology
Company, Inc. was 11% of total revenue for 2019 and 10% of total revenue for 2018 and 2017. No other customer exceeded 10% of our total revenue. Our sales to Huawei were included in our MBU, CNBU, SBU, and EBU segments and our sales to Kingston were included in our CNBU, MBU, and SBU segments.
We generally have multiple sources of supply for our raw materials and production equipment; however, only a limited
number of suppliers are capable of delivering certain raw materials and production equipment that meet our standards and, in some cases, materials or production equipment are provided by a single supplier.
